unary_unary_rpc: handle a unary-unary gRPC RPC by invoking the implementation with a single request and returning a single response
unary_stream_rpc: handle a unary-stream gRPC RPC by invoking the implementation with a single request and streaming multiple responses
stream_unary_rpc: handle a stream-unary gRPC RPC by iterating over streamed requests and returning a single response
stream_stream_rpc: handle a stream-stream gRPC RPC by iterating over streamed requests and streaming multiple responses
RequestIterator_class: iterate over incoming gRPC stream requests using the _RequestIterator class with handler and rpc context
